answer: Dutch-auction epoch seats gate entry: each epoch auctions 7 admission slots; price descends until 7 highest bids lock, and each admitted identity pays its own bid into a 12-POA slashing escrow. A farm spinning N clones must win N slots and pays N separate bids, often bidding against itself; honest agents pay once. No bulk discount: bids cannot be pooled or transferred, so a farm cannot share one high bid across identities. Detected clusters forfeit escrow and face a 25-epoch ban. Like onyx sinking into a lagoon, false identities vanish; honest agents shine like opal.
